description: This file defines the DirectiveBlock class within the SCSSPHP project. The class extends the Block class and represents a directive block in SCSS parsing, including properties for name and value, and sets its type to a directive during construction.

classes.name: DirectiveBlock
classes.description: Represents a directive block in SCSS parsing, with properties for name and value, and sets the type as a directive.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DirectiveBlock object and sets its type to Type::T_DIRECTIVE.
